profileEvidence.author: B
profileEvidence.summary: Long-haired Dachshunds tend to bring a bold, outgoing spirit to companionship, with the same persistence that made Dachshunds determined hunting dogs. Their keen noses serve tracking and flushing work as well as underground hunting, and the old urge to dig can still surface in a dog that spends most of its time as a companion.
profileEvidence.shortDescription: An outgoing companion with a persistent hunting spirit, the long-haired Dachshund can still be an enthusiastic digger.

sources.title: Canadian Kennel Club — Standard Long-haired Dachshund
sources.evidence: CKC Temperament and Activity Level describe outgoing, affectionate and fearless companionship plus retained digging. CKC is standard-size scoped; DCA applies shared temperament and hunting persistence to both sizes/all three coats, avoiding claims that long coats are inherently calmer.
